purpose: Adversarial negative controls for proposed lemmas. Never use these results as proofs or counterexamples for full active conjectures.

cases.statement: Every finite union-closed family containing a three-element set has at least one element of that set in half the family.
cases.warning: This published example refutes only the triple-local strengthening, not Frankl's conjecture.

cases.statement: If a finite union-closed family contains an exact two-element set {a,b}, one of a,b belongs to at least half of its members.
cases.warning: The checker verifies this sharp concrete example; a separate general injection proof is necessary for the universal theorem.

cases.statement: Every finite loopless 2-outregular digraph with all indegrees at most 3 has no arc from one below-average-indegree vertex to another.
cases.warning: The saturation condition is essential; this does not refute the degree-defect transfer theorem or Caccetta-Haggkvist.

cases.statement: Every oriented directed-triangle-free digraph on nine vertices with minimum outdegree at least two has at most 28 arcs.
cases.warning: The correct sharp upper bound is 29; this refutes only the proposed improvement to 28.
